user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content potentially used for training foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited during user queries or GPT Actions interactions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content potentially contributing to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for model development and training.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow: / directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to user-initiated queries.
user_agents.scope: User-directed web access when individuals ask Claude questions.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow: / directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes online content to improve search result relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Navigates the web to index content for search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow: / directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build Google search indexes, perform product crawls, and analyze content.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons for Google features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and image features in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot-Image or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video content for video-related Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot-Video or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl news content for Google News surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Googlebot-News or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Power Search testing tools including Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible content for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Internal research and development; does not affect specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Execute crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents; has no effect on Google Search or other products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API for Gemini, and Grounding with Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and collects data for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web search crawling and rendering across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls data use for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Secondary token governing use of crawled data; does not crawl webpages.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls registered content URLs for Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to display previews like title and thumbnail.
user_agents.scope: Content of an app or website shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule to robots.txt, though security checks may bypass it.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality and responses.
user_agents.scope: Online web content for citations and relevance enhancement in Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for Meta-WebIndexer in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content related to advertising and business products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-externalads in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and improves products by directly indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for foundation AI training and product improvement.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-externalagent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users or navigated by agentic AI.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler providing an open copy of the Internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Samples and crawls web pages across the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
